_help: Shown on the Platforms page. mode: auto = the bot fetches it every run (source = the feed key in Settings → Job feeds, or 'boards' for your company whitelist); watch = the bot checks the program's dates (program = key); link = no automation possible, but pasting a job link into + Add internship reads the details; manual = needs a login or blocks automated requests, so the bot can't use it (reason says why). Edit freely.

platforms.name: Internshala
platforms.note: Work-from-home listings in your categories (Settings → Job feeds). Detail pages are read once per internship for the stipend and full description.

platforms.name: Unstop
platforms.note: Public search API, one search per keyword in Settings → Job feeds.

platforms.name: Peerlist
platforms.note: Public jobs API, newest jobs first.

platforms.name: Company job boards
platforms.note: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workable boards of the companies on your whitelist.

platforms.name: Y Combinator jobs
platforms.note: YC's public jobs pages (the same YC startups as Work at a Startup, without the login).

platforms.name: Techstars & Antler portfolios
platforms.note: Getro-hosted VC portfolio boards. Add more Getro boards in Settings → Job feeds → VC portfolio boards.

platforms.name: Hacker News: Who is hiring?
platforms.note: Monthly thread via the HN Search API; posts that mention interns (or junior roles if enabled).

platforms.name: Himalayas
platforms.note: Public search API: internships open worldwide and to India.

platforms.name: Remote OK
platforms.note: Public API (credited and linked back, per its terms).

platforms.name: Remotive
platforms.note: Public API; small 24h-delayed sample, fetched at most every 6 h per its terms.

platforms.name: We Work Remotely
platforms.note: Category RSS feeds.

platforms.name: SimplifyJobs / Simplify.jobs
platforms.note: The repo's structured listings file (thousands of internships); only remote / India-eligible ones are evaluated.

platforms.name: speedyapply
platforms.note: International SWE internships table (includes India and remote roles).

platforms.name: Google Summer of Code
platforms.note: Paid, remote. The bot reads the official timeline API daily.

platforms.name: LFX Mentorship / CNCF mentoring
platforms.note: Paid ~12-week mentorships, three terms a year. Status from the CNCF mentoring repo (LFX's site blocks bots).

platforms.name: Outreachy
platforms.note: Two cohorts a year; no public data feed, so check the site. Track your application with + Add internship.

platforms.name: MLH Fellowship
platforms.note: Batches through the year; no public feed. Track applications with + Add internship.

platforms.name: Open Source Promotion Plan (OSPP)
platforms.note: Summer program; no public feed.

platforms.name: Google Season of Docs
platforms.note: Technical writing; check whether a season is running.

platforms.name: FOSSASIA internships / Codeheat
platforms.note: No public feed; check the site.

groups.name: Can't be automated (login or bot protection)

platforms.name: Wellfound (AngelList)
platforms.note: Serves a bot check to automated requests. Getting around that isn't something this tool does. Browse it and use + Add internship (fill the form).

platforms.name: YC Work at a Startup
platforms.note: Needs a login. Covered by the automatic Y Combinator jobs source above.

platforms.name: Otta / Welcome to the Jungle
platforms.note: Needs a login.

platforms.name: Handshake
platforms.note: Needs a university login (mostly US/UK universities).

platforms.name: WayUp
platforms.note: Serves a bot check; mostly US roles.

platforms.name: Built In
platforms.note: No public data feed and mostly US-only roles. Paste links to import.

platforms.name: Cutshort
platforms.note: Jobs load inside the app after sign-in; paste links to import.

platforms.name: Instahyre
platforms.note: Its search API has 13,000 full-time roles and no working internship filter (69 internships total).

platforms.name: Cuvette
platforms.note: Didn't respond to requests from this computer.

platforms.name: Peak XV, Lightspeed, a16z portfolio boards
platforms.note: Hosted on Consider, which rejects requests from outside its own page (CSRF check).

platforms.name: X (Twitter) searches
platforms.note: The X API is paid and needs your account; the link opens the advanced search from your list.

platforms.name: Discord / Slack #jobs channels
platforms.note: Reading servers needs a bot added by the server admins; automating your own account breaks Discord's rules.

platforms.name: Indie Hackers & Product Hunt
platforms.note: No jobs feed; these are for reaching founders directly.

platforms.name: remoteintech directory
platforms.note: A directory of remote-friendly companies, not job posts. Add ones you like to your Companies list (Test checks their board).

platforms.name: Forage
platforms.note: Free unpaid virtual programs, so outside your paid-only rule (still good for your CV).

platforms.name: Thiranex
platforms.note: Free (unpaid) virtual internships, so outside your paid-only rule.
